en.summary: Fixes replay control around atomic/LR/SC cache traffic. A request already being redirected into replay must not also allocate or probe miss structures, and a special-MSHR miss response must not advance in parallel with a new special miss request.
why_it_counts: The patch changes central DCache control logic in CoreReqPipe and SpecialMSHR.
The modified predicates directly affect replay correctness for cache-miss and atomic flows.
The commit adds LR/SC-oriented test scaffolding, consistent with a real failing hardware scenario.
disqualifiers: DCachev2 debug-print changes and new tests are auxiliary, not the core DUT fix.
evidence: CoreReqPipe.scala now also gates io.Probe_SMSHR.valid with !Req_RTAB_st1_valid.
L1MSHR.scala blocks missRspOut_st1 enqueue when io.missReq.valid is asserted in the same cycle.
The added LRSC.txt test input and AtomicUnit wrapper show the bug was exercised on atomic/LR/SC replay paths.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: When a cache request has already been classified as replay-only because of a miss-structure conflict, the pipeline must suppress normal miss allocation and special-probe side effects for that same request. If replayed atomic traffic is allowed to continue down normal miss/probe paths, the cache can create duplicate or conflicting state and lose correct LR/SC or AMO progress.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: replay suppression around miss and special-MSHR allocation
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: An atomic, LR/SC, or other replay-eligible request reaches a stage where replay has already been requested because of an outstanding MSHR/SMSHR/WSHR conflict.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Allow the replay-tagged request to keep asserting normal miss-allocation and special-probe valid signals, and allow a special miss-response queue to accept a response even while a new special miss request is being issued.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: drop replay-suppression predicate and remove request/response mutual exclusion
portability_notes: Map RTAB or replay-buffer terminology to whatever replay or retry structure the target DUT uses.
The bug is about duplicated side effects from a replay-only request, not about any single cache implementation detail.
If the target design has a special path for LR/SC or AMO misses, keep the injection localized to the point where replay and miss allocation interact.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the pipeline stage that decides whether a request is replay-only because of miss-structure pressure or an ordering hazard.
Remove the guard that blocks normal miss or probe allocation once replay has been requested for that request.
In the special miss-handling structure, remove any mutual exclusion that prevents a miss response from being accepted in the same cycle as a new special miss request.
Do not change the replay request itself; only allow the replayed request to leak extra side effects.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: Req_RTAB replay gating and SpecialMSHR miss-response enqueue
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix suppresses MissReq_MSHR and Probe_SMSHR when Req_RTAB_st1_valid is already set, and it prevents missRspOut_st1 from enqueuing while a new special miss request is active.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Remove the !Req_RTAB_st1_valid terms from MissReq_MSHR.valid and Probe_SMSHR.valid, and restore missRspOut_st1 enqueue to ignore concurrent io.missReq.valid.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Replaying atomic or LR/SC requests can allocate duplicate miss/special-MSHR state or race a returning response, causing stuck replay, wrong ordering, or cache-control deadlock.
evidence_for_injection: Both functional hunks add explicit suppression predicates; neither is a cosmetic change.
The affected signals sit exactly on miss allocation, special probe, and special miss-response interfaces.
The tests added in the same commit target LR/SC and atomic traffic, matching the replay-control bug.
notes: This is a control-side replay bug; the data arrays themselves are not the primary mutation point.
The DCachev2 hunk in this commit is debug output only.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了原子/LR/SC cache 流量周围的 replay 控制。一个已经被重定向到 replay 的请求，不应该再去分配或探测 miss 结构；同时 special-MSHR 的 miss response 也不应与新的 special miss request 并行推进。
why_it_counts: 补丁修改的是 CoreReqPipe 和 SpecialMSHR 中的核心 DCache 控制逻辑。
被修改的谓词直接影响 cache miss 与原子流的 replay 正确性。
提交新增了面向 LR/SC 的测试脚手架，符合真实硬件失败场景。
disqualifiers: DCachev2 的调试打印改动以及新增测试只是辅助内容，不是核心 DUT 修复。
evidence: CoreReqPipe.scala 现在用 !Req_RTAB_st1_valid 门控 io.MissReq_MSHR.valid。
CoreReqPipe.scala 也用 !Req_RTAB_st1_valid 门控 io.Probe_SMSHR.valid。
L1MSHR.scala 在同周期 io.missReq.valid 置位时禁止 missRspOut_st1 入队。
新增 LRSC.txt 输入和 AtomicUnit wrapper，说明该缺陷是在 atomic/LR/SC replay 路径上被触发的。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 当一个 cache 请求因为 miss 结构冲突而已经被判定为只能 replay 时，流水线必须抑制该请求继续产生普通 miss 分配或 special probe 副作用。如果 replay 中的原子流量仍然沿普通 miss/probe 路径前进，cache 可能生成重复或冲突的状态，从而破坏 LR/SC 或 AMO 的正确推进。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: replay 与 miss/special-MSHR 分配之间的抑制机制
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: atomic、LR/SC 或其他可 replay 的请求，因为已有 MSHR/SMSHR/WSHR 冲突而已经被要求进入 replay。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 让这个已标记为 replay 的请求继续拉高普通 miss 分配和 special probe 的 valid 信号，并允许 special miss-response 队列在发出新的 special miss request 的同周期继续接收响应。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: drop replay-suppression predicate and remove request/response mutual exclusion
portability_notes: 把 RTAB 或 replay buffer 的术语映射到目标 DUT 中对应的 replay/retry 结构即可。
该缺陷的本质是 replay-only 请求产生了重复副作用，而不是某个具体 cache 实现细节。
如果目标设计对 LR/SC 或 AMO miss 有专门路径，应把注入点限制在 replay 与 miss 分配的交界处。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到负责判断请求是否因 miss 结构压力或顺序冲突而只能 replay 的流水级。
删除 replay 已请求后用于阻止普通 miss 或 probe 分配的保护条件。
在 special miss 处理结构里，删掉阻止 miss response 与新 special miss request 同周期并存的互斥条件。
不要删除 replay 请求本身；只让 replay 请求额外泄露出本不该发生的副作用。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: Req_RTAB replay 门控与 SpecialMSHR miss-response 入队
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复在 Req_RTAB_st1_valid 已经置位时抑制了 MissReq_MSHR 和 Probe_SMSHR，并禁止 missRspOut_st1 在新的 special miss request 活跃时继续入队。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 去掉 MissReq_MSHR.valid 和 Probe_SMSHR.valid 上的 !Req_RTAB_st1_valid 条件，并把 missRspOut_st1 的入队逻辑改回忽略并发 io.missReq.valid。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 被 replay 的 atomic 或 LR/SC 请求会分配重复的 miss/special-MSHR 状态，或与返回响应竞争，导致 replay 卡死、顺序错误或 cache 控制死锁。
evidence_for_injection: 两个功能性 hunk 都是显式增加抑制谓词，而不是样式改动。
被修改的信号正好位于 miss 分配、special probe 和 special miss-response 接口上。
同一提交增加的测试针对 LR/SC 与 atomic 流量，与该 replay 控制缺陷吻合。
notes: 这属于 replay 控制缺陷，主要注入点在控制路径而不是数据阵列。
本提交中的 DCachev2 改动只是调试输出。
